name: a product PR whose changed files' text is past the inline budget, on the panel (#1135)
why: Real refusal 2026-11-21 (PR #1135): a small diff whose changed files came to 364,000 characters of text, over the 200,000-character budget for changed files. Files past the budget went unread, so code couldn't call the input whole, and on the panel a second reviewer's unsure sent it back every time. Every changed file is now inline or a read_file away, so the input is whole and an approve with an unsure approves. The change is exactly what the owner asked: a cost column on the board's runs table, with tests.
